text:
Maya Singh: Quick sync request 16 Need a short, shareable solution brief + gated one-pager aimed at security teams that compares deployment modes and explains SLA tradeoffs. Keep it tight: TL;DR, a small benchmark headline, and a ready-to-send paragraph AEs can email.
Carlos Vega: I'll take the benchmark copy. Can engineering give a single, defensible headline stat we can lead with? Prefer a comparative phrasing, not absolute promises.
Ruth Bennett: For the brief structure I suggest: 1) TL;DR (3 bullets) 2) Quick comparison (privacy, SLA, cost, time-to-live) 3) Migration guidance (pilot checklist) 4) What happens post-demo (timeline) 5) Appendix: methodology.
Theo Park: From product side: recommended phrasing for SLAs: Hosted: "Standard availability & quick onboarding" (99.5% typical), Dedicated: "Reserved capacity with enterprise SLA" (99.9% target), Private: "Customer-managed availability; Redwood provides installation and ops support".
Maya Singh: Good. Carlos, please avoid raw prices. Use ranges or percent improvement language. Eg: "Dedicated can lower unit inference cost by roughly ~40-60% at sustained scale; Private often yields the lowest unit cost when fully amortized."
Carlos Vega: Draft benchmark headline: "Predictable P95 latency with Dedicated; lowest unit cost when fully amortized on Private." Will follow with a 1-line methodology: "Benchmarks run on a chat-focused distribution (avg 130 tokens/request). See appendix for commands."
Ruth Bennett: For the gated one-pager form fields propose: email, name, company, title, company_size, deployment_interest, compliance_needs (multi), desired_sla, accept_contact. Add hidden field asset_id=deploy_brief_2026_q1.
Theo Park: Routing pseudo-rule for HubSpot: 
```
if form.deployment_interest == "private" or form.compliance_needs contains "FedRAMP" or form.company_size > 1000:
  assign -> "Enterprise-AE" + notify("Solutions-Eng")
elif form.deployment_interest == "dedicated" and form.company_size >= 100:
  assign -> "Mid-Market-AE"
else:
  assign -> "SDR-Nurture"
end
```
Maya Singh: Include a 1-paragraph "What to expect after you request a demo": "We'll triage your compliance tags, propose a pilot scope, and schedule a technical review within 3 business days. Solutions Engineering will provide an instance sizing recommendation and optional on-prem checklist."
Carlos Vega: Engineering numbers to reference (placeholder until CSV): P50 latency: Hosted 20ms / Dedicated 12ms / Private 25ms. P95 latency bands: Hosted 110-170ms / Dedicated 50-85ms / Private 95-160ms. Unit-cost guidance: Hosted baseline / Dedicated ~45% lower at scale / Private lowest amortized.
Ruth Bennett: Tone: direct, factual, and clear about tradeoffs. Add a short AE email snippet: 

"Hi <FirstName>,

Thanks for the interest. Attached is a short brief comparing Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments including typical SLA commitments and a short checklist for pilots. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min technical review to scope performance and compliance needs.

Best,
<AE name>"

Maya Singh: Love the AE snippet. Let's make sure the appendix contains the eval command and token distribution so security teams can validate methodology. Theo, can you paste the eval command we'll include?
Theo Park: Example reproducibility snippet for appendix: 
```
./evaluate --model redwood-dedicated-v2 --workload chat --seq-min 50 --seq-max 300 --samples 150000 --capture p50 p95 cost_per_million
```
Maya Singh: Timeline: copy draft by EOD tomorrow, design by day-after, gated page live in 4 days, social teasers scheduled to run the week of launch. LaunchBot: schedule reminders for asset deadlines.
LaunchBot: Draft assets reminder set for 2805040000. Gated page checklist created.
Carlos Vega: Action items: I'll provide the CSV + chart by tomorrow 10:00. Theo: confirm SLA phrasing and exact P95 numbers by EOD. Ruth: draft one-pager copy by tomorrow EOD. Maya: compile AE email and demo flow and upload to /marketing-assets/enterprise by deadline.
Maya Singh: Thanks team. Keep messaging honest about tradeoffs so our inbound is high quality. We'll reconvene after first draft review. :white_check_mark:
